## Design choices

I used a navy and teal color palette, a consistent card style, and responsive layouts that work on both desktop and mobile screens.

## Organization

The navigation connects the four required pages. The listing page is generated from the files in the `projects` folder, so it can grow without rebuilding the layout by hand.

## Publishing

Quarto renders the website to the `docs` folder. The source and rendered files are stored on GitHub, and GitHub Pages serves the website from the `main` branch's `/docs` folder.
